name: Discord
description: Discord organizes communities and teams around text channels, voice rooms, and real-time conversation.
best_for: Vendor positions it primarily for gaming communities and friend groups seeking a persistent, casual space rather than formal meetings.
features: Custom emoji, stickers, soundboards, and avatars
Real-time friend activity and status visibility
Integrated activities like watch-together and built-in games
Cross-device sync across PC, phone, and console
